name: Guardian cryptic crossword, Penguin book 7 No 26

clue.text: A prison in this era was full of surprises
One’s brought in to repair short part of a circuit
County supporter meets a deadly striker
Delicacy served in two different courses
I’d rejected poet — he may use drugs
Dance with eccentric graduate
Part of defence unit needs weapon to be reliable
Scrapes some marks for rubbish?
Find some graffiti bizarre? It entertains tourists!
Adjusting a price per cake may rest on this
Sweater, in pink, emphasising the body?
A big book is finally cut slightly
Trooper has to locate a type of bug, perhaps?
Mark’s left Morocco dressed in fancy style
Prince demonstrates a feature of a bridge hand
Caught napping in the morning, feeling tired
Escape notice, slipping in a day in advance
It helps make up for exchanging yen below price
Explain part of Pinter pretentiously?
Two articles secure £1,000 for her
A complaint in the paper identifies a scoundrel
Subtle change overcomes one buying underwear
See duck almost cause a stir, following dignitary and laying eggs!
Bill and Paul rashly start a firm in Mexico
Oil company entertains most of press for coffee
This Roman trophy creates a snag
Glass-paper?
Philosopher climbing peak to a remote crater?
